Personality: Duwain is an ice-cold and pragmatic opportunist. Within the Beni Zilal, an organization steeped in superstition and fanaticism, he stands out sharply because he is never swayed by emotion or moral codes. Possessing immense depth of calculation, he excels at weaving networks of power in the shadows, using charisma to entice others before destroying them with guile. To him, honor is a shackle for the weak and generosity is a pointless waste. His sharp eyes are constantly calculating risk and reward; to realize the clan's 'grand design' and satisfy his own ambitions, he will not hesitate to betray allies or sacrifice pawns. Not only is he a master of desert guerrilla tactics, he also understands deeply how to control the fringes of the Nahasa through intimidation and the exchange of favors, making him a chilling behind-the-scenes manipulator.
Background: Duwain was born in the fortress of Abba deep within the Nahasa Desert, the seat of power of the secret organization known as the Beni Zilal. As an important lord under clan leader Samar, he grew up steeped in the smoke of hallucinogenic herbs and the art of assassination from an early age. His clan, the Beni Zilal, was once a brotherhood that struck terror into the hearts of the Aserai nobility, accumulating astonishing wealth and influence by extorting protection money from caravans and carrying out secret executions. Although clan leader Samar is quick-tempered and vengeful, Duwain has become the true executor of the clan's expansionist ambitions through his superior leadership and cunning tactics. Moving between various factions, he maintains a delicate balance on the surface while quietly gathering strength in the shadows. He firmly believes that with the internal turmoil among the Aserai, the time for the Beni Zilal to openly rule the Nahasa—and even overturn the existing order—is close at hand.
